Store SAINT scores in a SummarizedExperiment

Source: R/summarized_experiment.R
saint_scores_to_se.Rd

Reshapes the result of run_saint() into a SummarizedExperiment with preys in rows and baits in columns. Every numeric column of the result, for example AvgP, SaintScore, FoldChange and BFDR, becomes an assay; prey-bait pairs without a score are NA. PreyGene is stored in the rowData. Character columns, such as the |-separated replicate values, are not kept.

Usage

saint_scores_to_se(scores)

Arguments

scores

A data frame returned by run_saint().

Value

A SummarizedExperiment with one assay per numeric score column.

See also

se_to_saint_input()

Examples

si <- list(
    inter = data.frame(
        ipId = c("IP1", "IP1", "IP2", "IP2", "IP3", "IP4"),
        baitId = c("BaitA", "BaitA", "BaitA", "BaitA", "Ctrl", "Ctrl"),
        preyId = c("Prey1", "Prey2", "Prey1", "Prey2", "Prey1", "Prey2"),
        quant = c(20, 1, 18, 1, 1, 1)
    ),
    prey = data.frame(preyId = c("Prey1", "Prey2"), preyGeneId = c("Gene1", "Gene2")),
    bait = data.frame(
        ipId = c("IP1", "IP2", "IP3", "IP4"),
        baitId = c("BaitA", "BaitA", "Ctrl", "Ctrl"),
        CorT = c("T", "T", "C", "C")
    )
)
scores_se <- saint_scores_to_se(run_saint(si, mode = "spc"))
SummarizedExperiment::assay(scores_se, "BFDR")
#>       BaitA
#> Prey1     0
#> Prey2     0
